name: IranCoJ Gunslinger Sounds
description: Call of Juarez: Gunslinger's gun sounds for the guns it has - Classic Gun, Quickshooter, Ranger, Winchester, shotgun, sawed-off: shots (yours and other players'), hammers, cylinders, reloads, empty clicks, the revolvers' draw and holster; five dynamite blasts - at the game's own loudness. Every other gun keeps its sounds. Use it instead of Gun Sound Mod.

replace:
${1}   // IranCoJ Gunslinger Sounds
    Param("WpnFXFire", "WpnFXRifleWinchesterGunslingerFire", "WpnFXRifleWinchesterFire")   // IranCoJ Gunslinger Sounds
    {   // IranCoJ Gunslinger Sounds
        SBAttack("data/sounds/irngunslinger/winchester/irngs_winchester_");   // IranCoJ Gunslinger Sounds
        SBAttackNoAmmo("data/sounds/irngunslinger/irngs_wctr_empty");   // IranCoJ Gunslinger Sounds
    }   // IranCoJ Gunslinger Sounds

${1}   // IranCoJ Gunslinger Sounds
    Param("WpnAttackFire", "WpnAttackRifleWinchesterGunslingerNoAmmo", "WpnAttackRifleWinchesterNoAmmo")   // IranCoJ Gunslinger Sounds
    {   // IranCoJ Gunslinger Sounds
        WpnFXHit("WpnFXRifleWinchesterGunslingerFire");   // IranCoJ Gunslinger Sounds
    }   // IranCoJ Gunslinger Sounds

${1}        SBPullOut("data/sounds/irngunslinger/irngs_pistol_pull_out");   // IranCoJ Gunslinger Sounds
        SBPutAway("data/sounds/irngunslinger/irngs_pistol_putaway");   // IranCoJ Gunslinger Sounds

${1}        SBPullOut("data/sounds/irngunslinger/irngs_pistol_pull_out");   // IranCoJ Gunslinger Sounds
        SBPutAway("data/sounds/irngunslinger/irngs_pistol_putaway");   // IranCoJ Gunslinger Sounds

${1}        SBPullOut("data/sounds/irngunslinger/irngs_pistol_pull_out");   // IranCoJ Gunslinger Sounds
        SBPutAway("data/sounds/irngunslinger/irngs_pistol_putaway");   // IranCoJ Gunslinger Sounds
